answer: Every submission must name 3 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The vertex graph is validated at intake and the jade frontier is published, as a result the ancestry of every answer is public, and umber anchors the chain at a checkpoint. An attacker who wants 10 percent of the vote must hold 29 percent of the bonded float for 70 days, which is capital that earns nothing while it waits. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
